_what_is: One entry per type of business you want to find. 'osm' = OpenStreetMap tag filters [key, regex] (a business matches if ANY filter matches; see https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Map_features); 'searches' = web search terms (Brave) combined with each city; 'keywords' = lowercase words that confirm on the company's own site that it is this type of business; 'subject' and 'block' = the email subject (lowercase, no sales hook) and the paragraph describing what you offer this type of business, one per locale; 'offer' = which entry of variants.json it uses; 'priority' 1 = best, 3 = worst; 'active': false switches a sector off. Delete the sample and add yours. 'always_exclude' lists what is never contacted, whatever the sector.

sectors.name: REPLACE_ME Sample sector (for example: independent dental practices)

block.en: REPLACE_ME one paragraph: what you do for this kind of business, in their words.

always_exclude._why: Whom you never contact, whatever the sector: government, large hospitals, chains, competitors.
